relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) plays a crucial role in the activation of NF-κB, thereby leading to NLRP3 inflammasome activation

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: the NLRP3 inflammasome initiates a cascade of molecular events through the activation of caspase-1, which facilitates the production of cytokines, such as interleukin-1β (IL-1β) and IL-18, from their pro-forms

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, which plays a crucial role in activating microglia to release pro-inflammatory mediators in the CNS

key_findings: Review proposes that chronic pain dysregulates microglial NLRP3 inflammasome activity, driving neuroinflammation that may promote Aβ deposition and Alzheimer's disease
Evidence for microglial NLRP3 involvement in CP/AD comorbidity is currently limited
